title: 第一卷 第3章 农桑要术
slug: 一路逃荒一路富手握空间带飞全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

沈鹿溪在空间里转了一圈，把每个角落都摸了个遍。

窑洞是空的，能放东西。

泉水是活的，尝了一口，清甜。

藏书阁的门推开了，里头灰扑扑的，大部分书架上蒙着一层看不透的灰雾，碰不着，只有最下面一排能拿到书。

她抽出一本，封面写着《农桑要术》，翻了几页，讲的是堆肥和种地的法子。

沈鹿溪把书塞回去，快步走回那片荒地。

她从衣兜里掏出几粒东西。

是上山之前顺手从院墙根底下薅的野菜籽，本来打算找到野菜丛以后做标记用的，随手揣了一把。

她蹲下来，用手指在干裂的泥地上戳了几个小坑，把野菜籽一粒一粒按进去，又从泉眼那儿捧了几捧水浇上。

泉水渗进土里，干裂的泥块颜色变深了一点。

沈鹿溪拍了拍手上的土，站起来。

行了，先试试。

要是这地真能种出东西，还能比外头快，那她翻身的本钱就有了。

她定了定神，心里想着“出去“，眼前一花，又回到了山洞里。

白骨还靠在石壁上，洞里安安静静的。

手心里的玉坠已经不发光了，看着就是一块普通的碧玉。

沈鹿溪把玉坠贴身收好，用衣襟裹了两层，塞进贴身的里衣口袋。

她对着白骨拱了拱手：“多谢前辈。这东西我收下了，一定物尽其用。”

然后弯腰钻出山洞，回到了坡地上。

太阳已经升高了，林子里鸟叫得正欢。

沈鹿溪把撒落的草药一株一株捡回竹筐里，又在附近找到了那片腐木林，摘了大半筐野山菌。

下山的路上，她走得比上山时快。

脑子里盘算个不停。

空间种地，速度比外头快，还能存东西，粮食放进去不怕坏。

藏书阁里有农书，能学技术。

有这样一个洞天，足够她干大事了。

不过眼下最重要的是把今天采的草药和山菌拿到镇上卖掉，换成真金白银。

等回去以后再进空间看看，那几粒野菜籽到底发没发芽。

要是发了芽，她明天就开始正式种地。

沈鹿溪背着满满一筐山货，脚步轻快地往山下走。

竹筐压在肩上沉甸甸的，她一点都不觉得累。

沈鹿溪回到家的时候，日头已经升到了头顶。

沈小满守在院门口，一看见姐姐的身影就蹦了起来：“姐！你可算回来了！”

跑过来要接竹筐，沈鹿溪侧身躲了一下：“别碰，里头有草药，碰碎了不值钱。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Shen Luxi walked around the space and touched every corner.

The cave dwelling is empty and can be used to store things.

The spring water is alive, and after a sip, it is sweet.

The door of the library was opened, and it was dusty inside. Most of the bookshelves were covered with an invisible layer of gray fog and could not be touched. Only the bottom row could get the books.

She pulled out a book with "Essentials of Farming and Mulberry" written on the cover and turned through a few pages. It talked about composting and farming methods.

Shen Luxi stuffed the book back and walked quickly back to the wasteland.

She took out a few grains from her pocket.

They were wild rape seeds that I picked up from under the courtyard wall before going up the mountain. I originally planned to use them as markers after I found the wild vegetable bushes, so I picked up a handful.

She squatted down, poked a few small holes in the cracked mud with her fingers, pressed the wild rape seeds into them one by one, and poured a few handfuls of water from the spring on them.

The spring water seeped into the soil, and the color of the cracked mud became a little darker.

Shen Luxi patted the dirt on his hands and stood up.

Okay, let’s try it first.

If this land can really grow something, and it can grow faster than outside, then she will have the capital to make a comeback.

She calmed down and thought "get out", her eyes flashed, and she returned to the cave.

The bones were still leaning against the stone wall, and the cave was quiet.

The jade pendant in the palm of my hand no longer glowed, and looked like an ordinary piece of jasper.

Shen Luxi put the jade pendant close to her body, wrapped it twice with the placket of her clothes, and stuffed it into her inner pocket.

She cupped her hands towards the bones and said, "Thank you, senior. I have accepted this thing and will make the best use of it."

Then he bent down and got out of the cave, returning to the slope.

The sun has risen and the birds are chirping happily in the woods.

Shen Luxi picked up the scattered herbs one by one into the bamboo basket, then found the rotten wood forest nearby and picked most of the basket of wild mushrooms.

On the way down, she walked faster than on the way up.

I'm thinking about it all in my head.

Farming in space is faster than outside, and it can also store things. Food can be put in without fear of spoilage.

There are agricultural books in the library, where you can learn techniques.

Having such a cave is enough for her to do great things.

But the most important thing right now is to take the herbs and mountain mushrooms collected today to the town and sell them in exchange for real money.

Wait until you get back and go into the space to see if those wild rapeseeds have germinated.

If it sprouts, she will start planting officially tomorrow.

Shen Luxi carried a basket full of mountain products on his back and walked briskly down the mountain.

The bamboo basket was heavy on her shoulders, but she didn't feel tired at all.

When Shen Luxi returned home, the sun had already risen above her head.

Shen Xiaoman stood guard at the entrance of the hospital. When he saw his sister's figure, he jumped up: "Sister! You are finally back!"

Running over to take the bamboo basket, Shen Luxi ducked sideways and said, "Don't touch it. There are herbs in it. It's worthless if it's broken."
